source.commit_message: fix(v2-06): close hosted and worker safety gaps

source_repairs.summary: Migration 0036 makes hosted auth database rows Google-only and replaces the admission function without an email/password credential branch; pre-existing credential rows fail closed at migration time.
Personal-worker claim recovery and HostedVideoWorkflow now increment replay_count, append durable replay events, and terminal-fail at the database-bound limit of 32 with an explicit failure event.

The personal worker now validates strict HTTPS URLs before network use, fails closed when Windows sleep assertions fail, confirms macOS launchctl unload before deleting autostart state, and validates configuration/tool identity before copying or launching an external bundle.
Runtime database configuration now requires a PostgreSQL hostname with exactly one sslmode=require and exactly one channel_binding=require.
Hosted Better Auth remains explicitly Google-only at the application configuration and deployment validation layers; email/password and email delivery remain disabled.
Expired hosted leases, deadline-fenced requeues, device revocation, replay limits, and Workflow expiry now append durable recovery events under database time and row locking.

The personal worker validates exact result status and attempt lineage, observes cancellation through download/process/upload, bounds result bytes, and acknowledges completion only after the exact durable response.
source_repairs.release_truth: The separately recorded media-worker-v0.1.6 artifact remains unchanged; this source repair has not been rebuilt, published, or installed.

source_repairs.summary: Deployment and operations validation requires protected PostgreSQL services with TLS/channel binding, rejects credential argv/passfiles, enforces exact grants and FORCE RLS checks, uses encrypted no-clobber backup envelopes, and applies the exact secret allowlist and rollback snapshot policy.
